name: Layered glazing
summary: A glaze is put on in several thin coats with a firing or a drying step between them. The layers make a thick, deep and soft surface.
how: Dip or brush a thin coat of glaze and let it dry.
Repeat the coat up to ten times.
Fire the pot in reduction, so that the glaze turns green and soft.

origin.note: Longquan potters build a thick celadon glaze from several coats.

adoptions.via: Longquan kilns put a thick, jade-like glaze on the body in several coats.
